rows.sourceLocation: specification/closed-loop-reliability-controlling-implementation-specification.txt: canonical-json/1 array order and non-JSON rejection contract; user section 7
rows.observableExpectedBehavior: Reject an array with an enumerable own name that is not its exact canonical decimal array index. Never omit a substantive extra property from a successful canonical preimage. Ordinary dense arrays retain their exact ordered preimage.
rows.applicableStages: Every stage and operation hashing canonical structured data, including response ingestion, execution identities, project snapshots and backup/restoration.

rows.observableExpectedBehavior: Reject getter/setter-backed array elements without invoking accessors. Repeated canonicalization and streamed hashing of the same invalid object must reject instead of executing code or producing different successful preimages.
rows.applicableStages: Every stage and operation using the shared canonical hash authority.

rows.sourceLocation: specification/closed-loop-reliability-controlling-implementation-specification.txt: closed JSON hash-preimage and implementation-object rejection contract; user section 7
rows.observableExpectedBehavior: Reject symbol-keyed properties for arrays just as for ordinary objects rather than silently dropping non-JSON data. Dense JSON arrays remain valid.

rows.sourceLocation: specification/closed-loop-reliability-controlling-implementation-specification.txt: section 17.11 and mandatory test 219; user section 7
rows.observableExpectedBehavior: Accept valid four-digit Gregorian dates including years 0000 through 0099, reject invalid month/day/leap combinations, and normalize instants without remapping those years to 1900 through 1999. Date-only values remain date-only and original external offset input is preserved.
rows.applicableStages: All stages and transports whose registered date-time normalizer consumes date-only or external instant values.

rows.sourceLocation: specification/closed-loop-reliability-controlling-implementation-specification.txt: section 17.11 requires RFC3339 UTC uppercase Z exactly three fraction digits; RFC3339 four-digit year grammar
rows.observableExpectedBehavior: Reject an offset instant whose UTC normalization would require a year outside the four-digit RFC3339 domain. Do not report a successful RFC3339 normalization containing an expanded signed six-digit year.
rows.applicableStages: Every stage accepting an external instant through the registered normalizer.
